name: onda
description: Find the videos that outgrow their author. Onda watches the Instagram, YouTube and TikTok creators you follow and gives Hermes their Hits — publications with far more views than the author has followers — along with your Projects, followed creators and plan usage; on your request it runs a new collection or transcribes Instagram videos. Hosted MCP server, browser sign-in with an emailed code (OAuth, no API key); needs a paid Onda plan and one extra command after install: hermes mcp add onda --url https://api.getonda.ru/mcp --auth oauth --connect-timeout 300.
